tweet.text:
What began as the study of steam engines revealed the fundamental nature of information itself.   

In 1865, Clausius tracked heat loss through dS = δQ / T, measuring disorder in physical engines. Boltzmann and Gibbs unified physics with probability through S = -k_B Σ p_i ln p_i, showing that state counting defines physical structure.   

Shannon proved H = -Σ p_i log₂ p_i measures uncertainty, and Landauer closed the loop with Q_min = k_B T ln 2, proving that erasing data costs physical energy.
